class="group min-w-0 text-4xl font-medium leading-tight mb-8 text-foreground" id="remote-development">远程开发<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h1>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">ZCode 远程开发用于把工作区放到远程主机、WSL 发行版或本机容器里运行。连接成功后，文件读取、终端命令、Git 操作和 ZCode Agent 都会在目标环境内执行；桌面端仍负责账号、模型配置、任务入口和界面交互。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">这适合需要在服务器、内网机器、GPU 开发机或容器环境中工作的项目。你可以在本机继续使用 ZCode 的桌面体验，同时让 Agent 直接访问目标环境里的代码、依赖和命令行。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="scenarios">适合什么场景<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">项目代码和依赖只在远程 Linux 服务器上可用。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">需要使用远程机器上的 GPU、内网服务、数据库或专用工具链。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">在 Windows 上开发，但项目依赖 Linux 环境，希望直接在 WSL 里跑。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">想在本机 Docker 容器中隔离项目依赖，不污染本机环境。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">本机性能或系统环境不适合直接运行项目，但仍希望使用 ZCode Agent 完成开发、调试和验证。</li>
</ul>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="before-connecting">连接前准备<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<blockquote class="border-l-4 border-border bg-muted/5 px-4 py-2 italic text-muted-foreground mb-4">
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">目标环境需要 POSIX shell。</strong> 当前不支持连接原生 Windows 远程主机。如果你要用的是 Windows 本机上的 Linux 环境，请选择 WSL。</p>
</blockquote>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">使用 SSH 连接前，请先确认：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">本机可以通过 SSH 访问目标主机。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">你知道主机地址、端口和用户名。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">目标主机支持密码登录，或你已经准备好私钥文件和可选的私钥口令。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">如果使用 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">~/.ssh/config</code>，可以先在终端执行 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">ssh &lt;Host别名&gt;</code> 验证别名可用。</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">使用 WSL 连接前，请先确认：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">你在 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Windows 桌面端</strong>，这是 WSL 入口出现的前提。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">本机已经安装 WSL，并且至少有一个发行版可用。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">想指定某个 Linux 用户时，确认该用户在发行版里确实存在。</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">使用 Docker 连接前，请先确认：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">本机 Docker daemon 正在运行。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">目标容器已经启动。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">容器内能访问项目目录，并具备项目运行需要的 shell、Git、Node.js 或其他工具链。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">如果容器列表没有显示目标容器，你仍可以手动输入容器名或容器 ID。</li>
</ul>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="open-remote-connection">从 ZCode 打开远程连接<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">在左侧边栏的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">项目</strong> 区域点击右侧的 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">+</code>，选择 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">远程连接</strong>。新任务页的工作区选择器里也能进入，主界面右下角的项目名称菜单同样保留了这个入口。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20260731-remote/workspace-picker-remote-annotated.webp" alt="新任务页的工作区选择器里也有「远程连接」" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">向导会先让你选择连接方式：</p>
<div class="mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">方式</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">连到哪里</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">出现条件</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">SSH</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">远程主机</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">全平台</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">WSL</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">本机的 Windows Linux 子系统</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">仅 Windows 桌面端</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Docker</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">本机正在运行的容器</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">全平台</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20260731-remote/kind-step-macos.webp" alt="连接方式选择页，macOS / Linux 上只有 SSH 和 Docker 两项" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">选择方式后点击 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">下一步</strong>，进入对应的配置页面。向导左侧会显示当前步骤：选择方式、填写配置、连接中、选择目录。连接过程较慢时，可以根据日志判断当前进度。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="ssh">使用 SSH 连接远程主机<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">SSH 页面用于填写远程主机的连接信息。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/remote-development-ssh-settings-20260701.png" alt="填写 SSH 连接配置" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">你可以按下面顺序配置：</p>
<ol class="mb-4 list-decimal list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">SSH 配置别名（可选）</strong>：ZCode 会读取本机 SSH config 中的可用别名。选择别名后，会自动填充主机、端口、用户名和私钥路径。没有别名时，保留“不使用别名”并手动填写即可。注意：ZCode 使用内置 SSH 客户端直连，别名只用于<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">预填以上四个字段</strong>——<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">ProxyJump</code> / <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">ProxyCommand</code> 等跳板配置不会生效，含跳板的别名会被当作直连主机处理。需要经跳板访问的主机，请先在本地建立端口转发（如 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">ssh -L</code>），再让 ZCode 连接转发端口。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">主机</strong>：填写远程主机地址或 IP，例如 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">192.168.1.100</code>、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">dev.example.com</code>。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">端口</strong>：默认是 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">22</code>。如果服务器使用跳板端口或自定义端口，请改成实际端口。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">用户名</strong>：填写远程登录用户，例如 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">root</code>、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">ubuntu</code>、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">deploy</code>。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">认证方式</strong>：选择 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">密码</strong> 或 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">私钥</strong>。私钥方式需要填写私钥文件路径，私钥有口令时再填写私钥口令。密码和私钥口令不会明文写进连接历史；连接成功后它们会加密保存在本机的凭据存储里，供之后重连使用。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">资源下载方式</strong>：首次连接时，ZCode 会准备远端运行所需组件。默认 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">本地下载后上传</strong> 由本机下载资源后传到远端；<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">远端服务器下载</strong> 会让远端直接访问 ZCode CDN，可减少上传等待，但远端需要能联网，并具备下载、解压和校验工具。</li>
</ol>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">填写完成后点击 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">开始连接</strong>。连接成功后，ZCode 会进入远端目录选择步骤，你可以选择要作为工作区打开的目录。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="wsl">使用 WSL 连接本机 Linux 子系统<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">WSL 入口 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">只在 Windows 桌面端显示</strong>，适合项目依赖 Linux 工具链或运行环境的场景。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">连接配置只有两项，均可留空：</p>
<ol class="mb-4 list-decimal list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">发行版</strong>：ZCode 会检测本机已安装的 WSL 发行版供你选择。留空时连接系统默认发行版。即使没有检测到发行版，也可以保留为空，直接尝试连接默认发行版。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Linux 用户</strong>：决定 ZCode 在 WSL 中以哪个用户身份工作。留空时使用该发行版的默认用户；填写后，Agent、终端命令、Git 操作以及文件的读取和创建都会使用这个用户的身份和权限。填写的用户必须已存在于该发行版中。</li>
</ol>
<blockquote class="border-l-4 border-border bg-muted/5 px-4 py-2 italic text-muted-foreground mb-4">
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">请谨慎使用 root。</strong> 以 root 连接后，在工作区中新建的文件可能归 root 所有，之后使用普通用户时可能无法修改。除非确有必要，建议使用日常开发所用的普通用户。</p>
</blockquote>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">连接成功并选择工作区目录后，文件读写、终端命令、Git 操作和 Agent 都会在所选的 WSL 环境中执行。和 SSH 一样，WSL 也支持将本机的 Skills、MCP 配置和 Plugins <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="#remote-sync">手动同步</a>到当前 WSL 用户的环境中。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="docker">使用 Docker 连接本机容器<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">Docker 页面用于选择或填写本机正在运行的容器。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/remote-development-docker-settings-20260701.png" alt="填写 Docker 连接配置" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">如果 ZCode 检测到运行中的容器，可以从 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">选择正在运行的容器</strong> 中选择。打开下拉框时，ZCode 会刷新一次容器列表，避免使用已经停止的旧容器。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">如果列表为空，或 Docker 当前没有返回完整列表，可以在 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">容器</strong> 输入框中手动填写容器名或容器 ID，例如：</p>
<pre class="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 mt-2 mb-4 p-4 overflow-auto border border-border"><code class="block text-foreground font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed language-bash">zcode-dev
7f3a8c2d9e10
</code></pre>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">Docker 连接通过 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">docker exec</code> 和 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">docker cp</code> 进入本机容器。它适合连接已经准备好项目环境的开发容器；如果容器尚未启动，请先在终端运行 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">docker ps</code> 确认可见。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="connection-log">首次连接与连接日志<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">点击 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">开始连接</strong> 后，向导会进入 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">连接中</strong> 页面。这里会显示实时连接日志，包括环境检测、远端资源准备、运行时初始化和失败原因。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/remote-development-connection-log-20260701.png" alt="查看远程连接日志" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">首次连接通常比后续连接慢，因为 ZCode 需要在目标环境准备远端服务和 Agent runtime。后续连接会复用已准备好的资源，只在版本变化或资源缺失时重新安装。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">如果连接失败，页面底部会显示错误摘要。你可以点击 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">上一步</strong> 修改配置后重试，也可以点击 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">去反馈</strong>，ZCode 会带上当前连接日志和截图，方便排查问题。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="after-connected">进入远程工作区后<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">连接成功并选择目录后，ZCode 会把该目录作为远程工作区打开。进入后你可以像本地工作区一样使用：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">在文件树中查看和编辑远程文件。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">让 Agent 阅读代码、修改文件、运行测试或执行命令。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">使用终端操作远程主机或容器内的 shell。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">使用 Git 查看状态、分支和提交。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">从左侧工作区列表重新进入或重新连接最近使用的远程工作区。</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">需要注意的是，远程工作区的项目文件、命令执行和 Agent runtime 都在目标环境内；模型供应商、登录账号、全局设置和用量信息仍保存在桌面端。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="remote-sync">把本地配置同步到远端<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">远程工作区里的 Agent 跑在目标主机上，因此本机装的技能、配置的 MCP 服务器和插件默认不会跟过去。ZCode 提供了三个同步入口，把它们一次性搬到远端。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">入口有好几处。最早的一处在连接向导里——SSH 和 WSL 走到 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">选择远程目录</strong> 这一步时，就已经可以先把配置同步过去，不必等工作区打开。连上之后，工作区标题栏的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">同步</strong> 下拉里有三项：<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">同步 Skill</strong>、<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">同步 MCP</strong>、<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">同步 Plugin</strong>；侧边栏工作区行的「更多」菜单，以及设置里对应的技能、MCP、插件页面也都有同一入口。本地工作区不显示这些菜单。</p>
<div class="mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">同步项</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">同步什么</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Skill</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">你本机的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">用户级</strong> 技能</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">MCP</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">你本机的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">用户级</strong> MCP 服务器配置</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Plugin</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">你本机的用户级插件；来自市场的插件会在远端重新安装</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">三者的共同规则：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">逐条勾选、手动触发</strong>，不会自动同步。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">远端已存在同名项一律跳过，不覆盖</strong>，列表里会标出来并默认不勾选。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">只同步 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">用户级</strong> 内容。项目级技能、工作区级 MCP、插件自带的 MCP 都不在范围内。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">如果远端目录写不进去，或者连接超时，ZCode 会在开始复制前就告诉你。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">部分失败不影响已成功的项，失败项会单独列出原因。</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">有几点需要特别留意：</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">同步不保证能用。</strong> 远端是否装了 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">npx</code>、Python 依赖或技能需要的命令行工具，ZCode 不做检查。同步过去的东西起不来，通常要你到远端手动补依赖。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">MCP 配置里的密钥会原样写到远端配置文件。</strong> 如果 MCP 服务器配置里有 API Key 或 Authorization 头，同步会把它们一起写过去，所以只对你信任的主机做这个操作。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">插件的敏感配置项不会同步。</strong> 标记为敏感的配置和路径类配置会被跳过，界面会提示还有几项需要你在远端手动填。另外市场插件是在远端重新安装的，<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">远端需要能访问对应的市场地址</strong>。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">同步过去的插件会在远端执行。</strong> 插件里的技能、命令、Hooks 和 MCP 都会在远端环境里加载运行，同步前请确认插件来源可靠。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">目前 SSH 和 WSL 远程支持这些同步操作。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="faq">常见问题<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="ssh-alias-missing">为什么 SSH 配置别名没有出现？<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">ZCode 会读取本机 SSH config 中可解析的别名。如果列表为空，可以先检查 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">~/.ssh/config</code> 是否存在、格式是否正确，并在终端执行 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">ssh &lt;别名&gt;</code> 验证。即使别名没有出现，也可以手动填写主机、端口、用户名和认证信息。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="remote-download">什么时候选择“远端服务器下载”？<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">当远端服务器访问 ZCode CDN 更快，或者本机上传到远端很慢时，可以选择 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">远端服务器下载</strong>。远端需要具备 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">curl</code> 或 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">wget</code>、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">tar</code>，以及 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">sha256sum</code>、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">shasum</code> 或 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">openssl</code> 中的校验工具。远端无法访问公网时（内网、离线环境），使用默认的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">本地下载后上传</strong>：由本机下载全部组件后经 SFTP 传到远端并安装到 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">~/.zcode/server</code>，远端全程无需联网。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="remote-proxy">远程连接会走设置里的 HTTP 代理吗？<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">不会。SSH 连接和 Web 远程控制通道都不经过设置中的 HTTP 代理，代理只覆盖模型、MCP 等出网请求——完整范围见 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="/docs/get-started/configuration#proxy-scope">HTTP 代理的作用范围</a>。远端服务器自身需要代理时，请在远端 shell 环境中自行配置。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="docker-container-missing">Docker 页面没有容器怎么办？<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">先在终端执行：</p>
<pre class="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 mt-2 mb-4 p-4 overflow-auto border border-border"><code class="block text-foreground font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed language-bash">docker ps
</code></pre>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">如果没有运行中的容器，请先启动容器。如果终端里能看到容器，但 ZCode 列表为空，可以手动输入容器名或容器 ID 后连接。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="connection-failure">连接失败时应该看哪里？<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">优先看 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">连接日志</strong> 最后一条 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">ERROR</code> 或页面底部的错误摘要。常见原因包括 SSH 主机不可达、端口错误、用户名或密码错误、私钥口令错误、远端缺少下载 / 解压工具、Docker 容器未运行。错误信息不足时，点击 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">去反馈</strong> 提交日志。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="remote-control-create-connection">手机 Remote Control 能新建或连接远程工作区吗？<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">不能创建全新的 SSH、WSL 或 Docker 连接——填写连接参数这一步必须在桌面端完成。但如果某个远程工作区已经登记在当前桌面窗口里、只是显示为断开，<a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="/cn/docs/remote-control">Remote Control</a> 可以对它发起重新连接，实际连接过程仍由桌面端执行。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
